name: nmap
description: Port and service scanner, the standard first step of any recon.

name: masscan
description: Very fast port sweep over large ranges (CIDR blocks, /16 and bigger).

name: dnsutils
description: dig, nslookup and host for DNS lookups (A, MX, TXT, NS records).

name: whois
description: Registration and ownership records of a domain or IP range.

name: traceroute
description: Shows the routers between the phone and a target.

name: netdiscover
description: Finds hosts on the local network by listening to ARP traffic (root helps).

name: arp-scan
description: ARP sweep of the local subnet to list live devices.

name: nbtscan
description: Reads NetBIOS names of Windows machines on the network.

name: smbclient
description: Lists and browses SMB shares (Windows file shares).

name: enum4linux
description: Pulls users, shares and policies out of SMB/NetBIOS services.

name: whatweb
description: Fingerprints the software behind a web page (CMS, server, versions).

name: wafw00f
description: Detects whether a web application firewall sits in front of a site.
install: python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages --upgrade wafw00f || python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade wafw00f

name: nikto
description: Classic web server misconfiguration and file scanner.

name: nuclei
description: Template driven scanner for thousands of known issues and exposures.
install: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends nuclei || (DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q unzip curl && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/nuclei.zip https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei/releases/download/v3.3.5/nuclei_3.3.5_linux_arm64.zip && unzip -o /tmp/nuclei.zip -d /usr/local/bin && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/nuclei)

install.name: ffuf
install.description: Fast content and parameter discovery with a wordlist.

install.name: gobuster
install.description: Directory, DNS and vhost brute forcing.

install.name: sqlmap
install.description: Finds and exploits SQL injection in web apps and APIs.

install.name: curl
install.description: Fetches URLs, used by several lookups (crt.sh, wordlists).

install.name: hydra
install.description: Online password guessing against many network protocols.

install.name: john
install.description: Offline password cracker (John the Ripper).

install.name: hashcat
install.description: GPU/CPU hash cracker with many modes.

install.name: binwalk
install.description: Inspects firmware and files for embedded archives and filesystems.

install.name: steghide
install.description: Reads and hides data inside JPEG and WAV files.

install.name: exiftool
install.description: Dumps and edits metadata (EXIF, GPS) of media files.

install.name: strings
install.description: Prints readable text out of binaries.

install.name: apktool
install.description: Decodes and rebuilds APK resources and manifest.
install:
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends default-jre-headless && curl -fsSL -o /usr/local/bin/apktool.jar https://bitbucket.org/iBotPeaches/apktool/downloads/apktool_2.10.0.jar && printf '#!/bin/sh
java -jar /usr/local/bin/apktool.jar "$@"
' > /usr/local/bin/apktool && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/apktool

install.name: jadx
install.description: Turns DEX bytecode back into readable Java source.

install.name: apkleaks
install.description: Scans APKs for URLs, keys and other secrets.
install: python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages --upgrade apkleaks || python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade apkleaks

install.name: dex2jar
install.description: Converts DEX files to JAR so a Java decompiler can read them.
install: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q unzip curl && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/dex2jar.zip https://github.com/pxb1988/dex2jar/releases/download/v2.4/dex2jar-2.4.zip && unzip -o /tmp/dex2jar.zip -d /opt && chmod +x /opt/dex2jar-2.4/*.sh && ln -sf /opt/dex2jar-2.4/d2j-dex2jar.sh /usr/local/bin/d2j-dex2jar

install.name: aapt
install.description: Reads APK metadata: permissions, exported components, badging.

install.name: apksigner
install.description: Signs and checks APK signatures.

install.name: zipalign
install.description: Aligns an APK so Android accepts the rebuild.

install.name: rizin
install.description: Modern reverse engineering framework (radare2 fork).

install.name: radare2
install.description: Binary analysis and patching framework.

install.name: adb
install.description: Android Debug Bridge, for wireless ADB push/install.

install.name: frida-tools
install.description: Frida command line client for hooking running apps.
install: python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages --upgrade frida frida-tools || python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade frida frida-tools

install.name: objection
install.description: Frida based runtime exploration and APK patching for non-rooted phones.
install: python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages --upgrade objection || python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade objection

install.name: mitmproxy
install.description: Intercepting HTTPS proxy with a web interface.
install: python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages --upgrade mitmproxy || python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade mitmproxy

install.name: tcpdump
install.description: Captures network packets into a pcap file.

install.name: netcat
install.description: Raw TCP/UDP connections and simple listeners.

install.name: bettercap
install.description: Network, WiFi and BLE attacks; ARP spoofing needs root.

install.name: searchsploit
install.description: Offline search of the Exploit-DB archive.

install.name: theHarvester
install.description: Collects e-mails, hosts and names for a domain from public sources.

install.name: sublist3r
install.description: Subdomain enumeration from public sources.
install: python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages --upgrade sublist3r || python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade sublist3r

install.name: sherlock
install.description: Finds a username across hundreds of sites.
install: python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages --upgrade sherlock-project || python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade sherlock-project

install.name: holehe
install.description: Checks whether an e-mail address is registered on many services.
install: python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages --upgrade holehe || python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade holehe

install.name: python3-pip
install.description: Python package manager, needed by the Python based tools.

install.name: git
install.description: Clones tool repositories.

install.name: jq
install.description: Reads and filters JSON on the command line.

install.name: unzip
install.description: Unpacks zip archives downloaded by other tools.

install.name: seclists-downloader
install.description: SecLists wordlist collection (around 1 GB) in /root/wordlists/SecLists.

install.name: rockyou-downloader
install.description: The classic rockyou password list in /root/wordlists/rockyou.txt.
